# sigma_jwk_set (Resource)

A JWK set whose active key signs JWT bearer assertions for connections configured with `useJwt` (reference it as `jwkSetId` in `sigma_connection.details_json`). Sigma generates the first key as active when the set is created; register `public_key` with your identity provider. Rotate with sigma_jwk_set_key. The `active_key_id`, `public_key`, `algorithm` and `expires_at` attributes follow whichever key is active, so after a rotation they change on the next refresh, not in the same apply; during a rotation, register each key's own `public_key` with the identity provider rather than this moving value. Destroying the set deletes all its keys and breaks any connection still using it; Sigma can't check for that.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A signing key set for a JWT bearer (OAuth) warehouse connection.
resource "sigma_jwk_set" "snowflake" {
  valid_for_days = 365
}

# Register this certificate with the warehouse / identity provider.
output "snowflake_jwt_public_key" {
  value = sigma_jwk_set.snowflake.public_key
}

# Reference the set from the connection's details.
resource "sigma_connection" "snowflake" {
  name = "snowflake-oauth"
  details_json = jsonencode({
    type      = "snowflake"
    account   = "MYORG-MYACCOUNT"
    warehouse = "ANALYTICS_WH"
    useOauth  = true
    useJwt    = true
    jwkSetId  = sigma_jwk_set.snowflake.id
    # ...other OAuth fields per Sigma's connection schema
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `valid_for_days` (Number) Lifetime in days of the first key's certificate (Sigma defaults to 365). Used only at creation; changing it later has no effect.

### Read-Only

- `active_key_id` (String) ID of the key currently signing for this set.
- `algorithm` (String) Signing algorithm of the active key (`RS256` or `ES256`).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry of the active key's certificate.
- `id` (String) JWK set ID.
- `public_key` (String) PEM X.509 certificate of the active key. Never includes private key material.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_jwk_set.example '<jwk_set_id>'
```
